note: #2767 item 9 (comment-looking text inside a Markdown link title masked as a real HTML comment): findHtmlCommentRanges's ignored-opener-ranges input only ever receives real code ranges (fenced/indented/inline); a link title is ordinary prose, never a code range, so the "<!--" opener inside the link title is not ignored. It is also unterminated in this body (no "-->" anywhere), so it masks from that point through end-of-body, swallowing the genuine, later "Maintainer decision (...)" marker entirely. Before #3282, evaluateAutonomousCompletion scanned the raw (unmasked) corpus, so the "Maintainer decision" trigger text itself was still visible and matched EXTERNAL_COORDINATION_PATTERN, while findInlineResolvedDecisionSpans's own internal masking hit this same gap and could not see the marker to exempt that match -- net effect: a false autonomous_completion FAIL. #3282 masks evaluateAutonomousCompletion's corpus through the same maskMarkdownForScan/findHtmlCommentRanges pipeline (per its own Proposed Change #1), so the unterminated opener now also swallows the "Maintainer decision" trigger text from the scanned corpus itself -- net effect flips to a false autonomous_completion PASS (no trigger text left to match at all). Check 7 verifiability still fails either way, since it reads the same masked marker text. Same root cause, different symptom -- not a fix, and not in #3282's scope (which never touches link-title awareness in findHtmlCommentRanges). The gap is present today (MATCH), now producing a permissive (false-PASS) rather than conservative (false-FAIL) misverdict.
